reason: The cleaning log and shoes-off rule are exactly what I look for, and I'd probably use the free first visit. But with daycare costs up, $14 a child plus gas for the drive is hard to justify when the park and library are free.
objection: It's a drive for us, and $14 per kid plus gas adds up fast. It also isn't open yet, so I can't read any reviews or see how clean it really is.
would_change_my_mind: Opening close to me with real reviews from other parents, plus a drop-in price around $8-10 a child, or a pack bringing each visit under $9.
